title: Tick 4ao duplicates the fixed defect; its record should say so
body:
Tick 4ao names the same under-bound dumb-git-origin test as the closed ticks 7oy/h3c, and that defect is fixed at every attempt base cut after 2405782ec (merged 2026-10-05). 4ao is still in_progress; its next attempt will find the work already in its base. The whole fix is a note on the tick's record so the run closes it against the fact rather than redispatching it blind.
evidence: commit 2405782ec raised harness/test/node/dumb-git-origin.test.ts's first test to timeout: 300_000; the full node suite (pnpm exec vitest run -c vitest.node.config.ts) passes at base 40284aa76
